purpose.summary: Add a default-off, build-only Chronik Rust foundation without linking or changing the standalone node.
scope: Ask one falsifiable question: does adding four locked Rust crates behind BUILD_CHRONIK_BUILD_ONLY=OFF leave the public node unchanged when OFF and produce only dormant Rust artifacts when explicitly ON?
Add the top-level BUILD_CHRONIK_BUILD_ONLY option with an OFF default; OFF does not enter chronik, discover Rust or Cargo, invoke Cargo, define a node macro, or add a node link dependency.
When explicitly ON, build and test offline with --locked only abc-rust-error, abc-rust-lint, bitcoinsuite-core, and bitcoinsuite-slp in an out-of-source Cargo target.
Import sixty byte-exact crate files and the exact donor MIT license from public Bitcoin ABC commit 38a7a4dc23a574f2747265fcdf33242648dd2ce1, tree 68d559f78c90ed38066283dc87f8652258a1415a.

Keep the native-assets boundary explicit: dormant SLP and ALP primitives exist, but observed, indexed, or reconstructed data, authoritative token validation or state, and governed consensus activation are all absent.
exclusions: No C++ bridge, callback, runtime option, thread, socket, file or datadir path, HTTP or WebSocket API, protobuf service, database, served index, plugin, or production-node link is added.
No consensus, mempool validation, chain selection, chain parameter, activation, testnet, mainnet, wallet, or user-interface behavior changes.
No indexing, runtime, API-compatibility, token-validity, deterministic-build, or reproducible-build claim is made.
No binary, Cargo cache, build directory, raw command output, absolute host path, parent environment, private history, operator material, or unrelated product material enters this change.

platforms: Ubuntu 22.04 ARM64 public verification after technical acceptance

limitations: BUILD_CHRONIK_BUILD_ONLY=ON is not the compiled-in-disabled role: no observer is linked into or started by the node.
The runtime opt-in, restart, full reindex, chainstate reindex, pruning, and deep-reorganization scenarios are not implemented by this change.
The committed lockfile fixes registry versions and checksums but does not lock the compiler, operating-system image, native toolchain, or final binaries.
A fresh Cargo cache requires one online population step before the governed build can run offline.
Thirty donor SLP integration-test files and chronik-util are deliberately deferred until they become reachable from a later bounded slice.
Local Rust 1.80.0 tests passed, but no result is public reproduction evidence at record-review time.

The local macOS node builds stopped symmetrically in unchanged legacy code because Boost 1.90 removed boost::filesystem::basename; node byte and link equality remain for a supported public build environment.
counterevidence: No public build or test of the exact candidate exists at record-review time.
Compiling token parsers does not demonstrate transaction observation, indexing, reconstruction, authoritative token validity, token state, or activation.
No compiled-in-disabled node or local-regtest-indexing runtime exists in this change, so every optional-indexing runtime scenario remains an Open Question.
